text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's right. You can count on me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I already have a stuffed bear in
my room that my grandparents gave me,
so I'm quite
accustomed to caring for
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of room, so I'll guard each
of them
with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's nice to have more friends.
